answer: Every new agent key earns its seat through a serial VDF mint: creating identity N consumes the output of mint N-1, so identity generation runs as one global queue at ten minutes per key. Ten thousand clones means sixty-nine days of unbroken sequential work before the last clone can even bid. A botnet adds cores, but cores do not shorten a chain that must execute in strict order, while peers re-verify each link for pennies. The lagoon stays clear because admission is a grove of onyx gates: each opens only after the one before it finishes its slow grind, no bypass lane.
